rv.q: Red-twist/ Isaac’s Eye provides an intimate setting and actors who know exactly how to bring a script to life — so keep an eye out for tickets.
Top-flight ensemble acting drives Redtwist Theatre’s production of this brainy, fanciful comedy by Lucas Hnath, author of A Doll’s House, Part 2.
Still, watching the men get to that point is riveting.

cn.t: This brainy, fanciful comedy about Isaac Newton's eye experiment earns praise for its top-flight ensemble acting and quick-talking dialogue, though the play presents a more complicated portrait of the famous scientist than history books suggest.
